thread:
marta: Heads up — customers in eu1 reporting sudden 502s on hosted inference right after the proxy upgrade rolled at 21:10 UTC. Affects chunked streaming and large-metadata requests. sample trace id: trace:01-abcdef123
ben: Got it. Do we have a count/rate?
marta: ~1200 502s in 10m from a handful of tenants, error budget alarm triggered. Most errors are upstream early closes. Excerpt from edge logs: 
```
[edge] ts=2026-03-18T21:12:03Z level=warn upstream_closed_early tenant=acme trace=01-abcdef123 reason=upstream EOF after headers
[envoy] upstream_response_time=- upstream_status=-
```
kyle: Any config diffs from the previous rollout?
ingrid: Rolling deploy changed proxy buffering and increased http/2 concurrent streams default. Also bumped max_header_bytes for the new build.
marta: The common repro: client opens http2 streaming with big metadata headers (~20k) + chunked body, keeps connection alive. After upgrade the proxy trims payload or resets. curl repro we got from customer: 
```
curl -v --http2 -H "X-Client-Meta: $(python -c 'print("A"*20000)')" \
  -H "Transfer-Encoding: chunked" \
  -d $'4\r\nWiki\r\n0\r\n' https://hostedapi.eu.redwood/v1/generate
```
devon: I reproduced locally with that curl and saw a connection reset from proxy at ~1s. tcpdump shows FIN from envoy to backend right after sending headers.
ben: That suggests the proxy saw an inconsistency between headers and buffered body and decided to abort. Any changes to proxy_buffering or body-buffer limits?
ingrid: New build added an optimization to pre-allocate header buffers and aggressively truncate trailing metadata for perf. Might be the culprit.
kyle: Can you paste full proxy config snip for http/2 handling?
marta: Config excerpt (sanitized): 
```
http2_protocol_options: { max_concurrent_streams: 250 }
server: {
  proxy_buffering: true
  proxy_max_mem: 32k
  max_header_bytes: 65536
}
```
devon: The proxy_max_mem looks low for 20k headers + chunk frames. When that limit hits we saw code path that returns 502 instead of buffering to disk.
ben: Trace shows upstream never got the body — edge closed mid-handshake. This fits.
marta: Customer provided curl + logs and is blocked. What's the mitigation path?
kyle: Short term: rollback the proxy binary to previous build — less aggressive memory truncation. Also temporarily set proxy_buffering: false and increase proxy_max_mem to 256k in eu1 load domain.
ingrid: Rolling rollback in progress now to prev build in eu1, started at 21:23 UTC.
ops-bot: deploy rollback eu1-proxy v2026.04 -> v2026.03 initiated by ingrid at 2026-03-18T21:23:12Z
devon: After rollback, I retested the customer's curl and it completed with 200 and streaming intact.
marta: Customer confirmed their integration resumed. Error rate dropped to baseline within 6m of rollback.
ben: Follow-ups: add a knob to fallback to disk-buffering when header+body > proxy_max_mem, and add a canary test that sends large header+chunked stream during proxy build stage.
kyle: I'll file an eng ticket for the fallback and test harness (ENGINF-4812). Also let's add an alert rule for "upstream_closed_early" spike so we catch next rollout fast.
ingrid: Noted — rollout paused and new patch in flight.
marta: Thanks team. Saving customer's curl sample and our packet captures to the support ticket. Closing this thread once ENGINF-4812 is tracked. :thumbsup:
